name: Multi-factor combination certified edge surfaced on the Combination lab + Evidence

steps.narration: Open the multi-factor combination lab — the page heading confirms we are in the right place.
Change leg 2 factor from ATR % (the default) to Proximity to 52-week high (high_proximity) — this selects the certified combination leg.
Click the Top button for leg 2 side (leg 2 defaults to Bottom; the certified combination needs top:tertile).
Click the Proven badge for the rs_spy_3m × high_proximity composite — it deep-links to /evidence#combination-high_proximity-rs_spy_3m-h20 and the combination row should be in view.
Navigate to the Evidence ledger and confirm the 6th combination row is rendered with the title 'rs_spy_3m × high_proximity — composite', proving the claim is in the canonical ledger.
